content: उत्सर्जनम् .²1 Leaving, abandoning, letting loose, quitting <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A gift, donation. .²3 Suspension of a Vedic study. .²4 A ceremony connected with this suspension (to be performed half yearly); पुष्ये तु च्छन्दसां कुर्याद् बहिरुत्सर्जनं द्विजः <ls>Ms. 4. 96</ls>; वेदोत्सर्जनाख्यं कर्म करिष्ये <ls>Śrāvaṇī Mantra.</ls>
